name: 84057 · Orem, UT
findings: ZIP 84057 (Orem) has 79 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84057 (Orem) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 84057 (Orem) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 45 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
